scholarships.name: Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.coverage: Tuition fee + Rs 4,000 monthly stipend
eligibility: Newly admitted students at HEC-recognized public sector universities
Family need criteria verified via BISP/NADRA poverty data
Admission secured on merit; not availing any other scholarship
scholarships.note: The largest need-based undergraduate program in Pakistan

scholarships.name: HEC Need-Based Scholarship Program
scholarships.coverage: University tuition fee + Rs 6,000 monthly stipend
eligibility: Enrolled in an undergraduate (4-5 year) program at an HEC-selected public university
Financial need assessed by the university's Institutional Scholarship Award Committee
Students admitted on self-finance basis are not eligible
scholarships.deadline: Cycle-based (apply via university Financial Aid Office)

scholarships.name: Scotland Pakistan Scholarships for Young Women and Girls
scholarships.coverage: Tuition fees for bachelor's degree courses at HEC-recognized universities
eligibility: Female citizens of Pakistan
Applying for a four-year bachelor's degree at an HEC-recognized university
Financial need and academic merit assessed by British Council
scholarships.note: Funded by the Scottish Government for women from disadvantaged backgrounds

scholarships.name: Coastal Region Higher Education Scholarship Program
scholarships.coverage: Tuition and hostel up to Rs 240,000/year, Rs 15,000/month living allowance and Rs 30,000/year book allowance
eligibility: Domicile of Gwadar, Lasbela/Hub, Kech (Turbat) or Awaran districts
At least 50% marks in both matriculation and intermediate from these districts
Maximum age of 22 years at the application closing date
Not already availing any HEC/Government scholarship
scholarships.note: Active HEC scheme for Balochistan's coastal districts; replaces the discontinued HEC Merit Scholarship

scholarships.name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Individual Financial Assistance (Education)
scholarships.coverage: University fees including boarding up to Rs 150,000 per year paid to institution
eligibility: Regular merit-based student in a public-sector educational institution
Family monthly income below Rs 74,000
Self-finance, private institute students and government employees' children are ineligible

scholarships.name: Alkhidmat Academic Scholarship
scholarships.coverage: Monthly stipend of Rs 9,000 to Rs 11,500 depending on program (up to Rs 138,000/year)
eligibility: Students enrolled in colleges, universities, medical or engineering institutions
Demonstrated financial hardship with supporting documents
Selection through online application and need assessment

scholarships.name: Shahid Afridi Foundation Education Scholarships
scholarships.coverage: Tuition fee support for students from underprivileged backgrounds (amount varies by program cycle)
eligibility: Pakistani students from underprivileged communities
Demonstrated financial need with supporting documents
Apply through the SAF scholarship form when a cycle is announced
scholarships.note: safoundation.org is defunct; the official domain is shahidafridifoundation.org

scholarships.name: Chief Minister Honhaar Scholarship Program
scholarships.funder: Government of Punjab (Punjab Higher Education Commission)
scholarships.coverage: 100% tuition fees
eligibility: Domicile of Punjab (current cycle also open to AJK students)
Family monthly income below Rs 300,000
FSc marks: at least 70% for sciences or 65% for arts; 80% for medical and dental colleges
Enrolled in selected disciplines at public universities or colleges
scholarships.note: 50,000 scholarships across 70 disciplines; Punjab's largest merit-based undergraduate scheme

scholarships.name: HBL Foundation Scholarship Scheme
scholarships.coverage: Semester stipend of Rs 8,000 to Rs 16,000 by discipline (Arts, Sciences, Engineering)
eligibility: Undergraduate students at partner universities such as MUST, Mirpur AJK
Financially challenged and low-income students
Advertised around January-February each year at participating universities
scholarships.note: HBL Foundation allocated Rs 177 million in Q1 2026 including scholarships

scholarships.name: Dalda Foundation Trust Scholarships
scholarships.coverage: Tuition fees + monthly stipend of Rs 10,000 to Rs 20,000
eligibility: At least 80% marks in matriculation
Admission secured in a government institution
Family monthly income and residential property within defined parameters
Selection on merit through written test and interview

scholarships.name: LUMS National Outreach Programme
scholarships.coverage: Fully-funded undergraduate scholarship (tuition, boarding and living costs)
eligibility: At least 80% marks in Matric or equivalent O-Levels
Demonstrated financial need
Selection through the NOP Summer Coaching Session and LUMS admission test

scholarships.name: IBA Karachi Need-Based Financial Assistance
scholarships.coverage: Bridge financing covering 25%-90% of tuition fee (up to 100% via donor scholarships)
eligibility: Full-time students in morning programs facing financial constraints
Minimum CGPA of 2.5 to maintain assistance
Income tax returns required for all earning family members
scholarships.deadline: Cycle-based (apply at admission or start of each academic year)

scholarships.name: GIKI Scholarships & Financial Assistance
scholarships.funder: GIK Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology
scholarships.coverage: Need-based and merit-based scholarships plus interest-free aid and loans
eligibility: Undergraduate (BS) students admitted to GIKI
Financial assistance form submitted with the admission application
Merit scholarships tied to admission merit positions
scholarships.note: Over Rs 200 million in scholarships and aid for undergraduate students

scholarships.name: NUST Need-Based Financial Aid
scholarships.funder: NUST (National University of Sciences and Technology)
scholarships.coverage: Need-based financial aid on tuition plus linkage to external scholarships
eligibility: Enrolled NUST undergraduate student
Financial need assessed via the NUST Need-Based Financial Aid Application Form (NFAAF)
Must apply for external scholarships such as Scottish, BEEF, CMEEF, SEEF and PEEF

scholarships.name: FAST-NUCES Scholarships & Financial Assistance
scholarships.funder: FAST-NUCES (National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences)
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition merit scholarships, interest-free study loans and external sponsorships
eligibility: Top 3 position holders of each examination board at admission
Continuation of merit scholarship requires semester GPA of 3.0 or higher
Need-based students may apply for interest-free study loans and external sponsorships

scholarships.name: COMSATS Merit Scholarship for Admission Toppers
scholarships.coverage: Full tuition fee waiver for the entire degree program
eligibility: Top candidate in the admission merit list of each undergraduate program per campus
Maintain minimum CGPA of 2.5 each semester
Award is campus and program specific and non-transferable
scholarships.deadline: Automatic (awarded at admission; renewed each semester)

scholarships.name: AKU Financial Assistance Programme
scholarships.coverage: Needs-based grant-in-aid combined with an interest-free student loan
eligibility: Students admitted to AKU programmes unable to pay tuition and other fees
Assistance based on demonstrated need assessed by the university
Loan repayable after graduation with 5% annual administrative charge
scholarships.deadline: Cycle-based (deadline in the admission offer package)
scholarships.note: Almost 50% of the AKU student body receives financial assistance

scholarships.name: University of the Punjab Scholarships
scholarships.coverage: Merit, merit-cum-need and need-based scholarships plus PEEF and donor funds
eligibility: Enrolled PU students in affiliated departments and colleges
Need-based aid for financially constrained students
Merit scholarships per department-wise and category-wise lists

scholarships.name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
scholarships.coverage: Tuition and stipend support across intermediate, graduation and master's levels
eligibility: Punjab domicile (also serves AJK, GB, ICT and other provinces via special quotas)
At least 60% marks or minimum CGPA 2.5 for master's level scholarships
Admission secured in an HEC-recognized institution
scholarships.deadline: Annually (special quota cycles advertised each year)

scholarships.name: Sindh Educational Endowment Fund (SEEF)
scholarships.funder: College Education Department, Government of Sindh
scholarships.coverage: Financial assistance for tuition at public and private universities
eligibility: Domicile of Sindh; students from low-income groups
Pursuing graduate or post-graduate studies in IT, engineering, medicine or business administration
Selection through online application, interview and fund trust approval

scholarships.name: Chief Minister Education Endowment Fund (CMEEF)
scholarships.funder: Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Higher Education Department)
scholarships.coverage: Fully funded: tuition, admission and hostel fees + Rs 5,000 monthly stipend
eligibility: Domicile of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Meet admission merit criteria at approved institutions such as UET, NUST, GIKI, AKU and IBA
Family monthly income must not exceed Rs 100,000
Not a recipient of any other scholarship for the degree program
scholarships.note: 272 undergraduate inland scholarships in selected leading institutions

scholarships.name: Balochistan Education Endowment Fund (BEEF)
scholarships.coverage: Merit-based and need-oriented scholarships from matric to PhD levels
eligibility: Domicile of Balochistan; talented and financially disadvantaged students
Student data verified through education boards and institutions
Out-of-province scholarships scheme for study outside Balochistan

scholarships.name: AJK State Talent Scholarships & AJK-PEEF Scholarships
scholarships.funder: Government of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (Higher Education Department) and PEEF
scholarships.coverage: Annual merit scholarships for AJK students from intermediate to master's level
eligibility: Domicile of Azad Jammu & Kashmir
Awarded on merit (state talent scholarships for 1,258 students each year)
Need and merit criteria per AJK-PEEF rules
scholarships.deadline: Cycle-based (announced by AJK Higher Education Department)

scholarships.name: Gilgit-Baltistan Educational Endowment Fund (GBEEF)
scholarships.funder: Government of Gilgit-Baltistan (Directorate of Education Colleges GB)
scholarships.coverage: Tuition fee, hostel fee, monthly stipend, books and travelling allowance
eligibility: Domicile of Gilgit-Baltistan
Enrolled students apply through the GB scholarships online portal
Awards announced per cycle by the Directorate of Education Colleges GB
